verdict.rationale: dlt's incremental loading and state management provide checkpoint-like resume behavior (dlt-docs-18, dlt-docs-20, dlt-docs-27) so a pipeline can pick up from the last loaded point rather than fully restarting, but the evidence pack contains no explicit documentation of automatic retry logic for transient failures (e.g., network/API retries, backoff) — a core half of the story. Missing for 10: explicit retry/backoff mechanism for transient failures, and confirmation that resumption is automatic (not just incremental extraction) after mid-run interruption.
